title: Columbus uses a predicted eclipse to make island natives feed his crew
summary: Chris Ramsay tells of Columbus uses a predicted eclipse to make island natives feed his crew, about 1504 at West Indies (speaker says the Bahamas; historically Jamaica), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: West Indies (speaker says the Bahamas; historically Jamaica)

tellings.quote: so, you know, Chris Columbus had said, "If you do not do what we ask, we will block out your son in 3 days time. You have 3 days." Mhm. And so, 3 days later, sure enough, there was a solar eclipse.

plain: A magician and YouTuber named Chris Ramsay, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, tells a story he credits in part to the writer Arthur C. Clarke. He says Christopher Columbus, stranded on a Caribbean island he places in the Bahamas, told the local people that if they did not help his crew he would block out the sun in three days, and three days later a solar eclipse came. Ramsay tells it to show how more advanced knowledge can look like magic to those without it.
